title: Amazon Abandons 4 Virginia Data Centers on $427M Site
summary:
Local residents successfully blocked the construction of new computing facilities in the region through widespread opposition. Amazon withdrew its plans to build four data centers on the 122 acre former GWU Ashburn campus in Loudoun County, which it had purchased for roughly $427 million.

The company will donate 25 acres of the property to the local government to develop a community arts center. This decision marks the end of the company's attempt to utilize the former academic site in Northern Virginia for its cloud infrastructure expansion.
